# A conversion of a variable is loop-invariant, so it is broadcast once before the loop.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Centroid(sum []float64, dim int) {
	for i := range sum {
		sum[i] /= float64(dim)
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func Centroid(sum []float64, dim int) {
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(float64(dim))
	for _i := 0; _i < len(sum); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(sum[_i:])
		_v1.Div(_vcFloat64s0).StorePart(sum[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	sum := []float64{2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18}
	test.Centroid(sum, 4)
	fmt.Println(sum)
}
-- testmain/output --
[0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 4.5]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func Centroid(sum []float64, dim int) {
	for i := range sum {
		sum[i] /= float64(dim)
	}
}
